reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

flags.reason: generalises-example: The guide's "so the labels fit again" describes one specimen: a 248 px host where Request needs 94 px at Size S and gets 99 px. The item makes it a general remedy for any narrow host that cuts labels short. Switching to Size S lowers the width a label needs, but at narrower hosts or with longer labels the labels can still truncate.

notes: /examples/2 uses iconName "ic_share". Neither the guide nor the evidence names that icon. The evidence only gives the label "Share", and the Storybook icons are ic_qr_code, ic_photo and ic_menu. Because ic_menu turned out to be missing from the 0.1.60 icon registry, someone should check that ic_share exists before publishing the example. /anatomy/2 marks Gap as alwaysPresent=true, but a group with a single child has no neighbours to separate. This is minor.
